description: Pin/Unpin menu actions for a running unpinned window actually change its pinned state, and Settings, About, and Quit are provided enabled.

assertions.comment: Right-clicking a pinned launcher offers unpinning
assertions.pixel_exempt: The menu is built and its entries are read in-process, but Wayland only maps a popup for a real grabbing parent surface, so whether anything paints here is a race. Judged on the menu model, never on pixels.

assertions.comment: Right-clicking an unpinned window item offers pinning
assertions.pixel_exempt: The menu is built and its entries are read in-process, but Wayland only maps a popup for a real grabbing parent surface, so whether anything paints here is a race. Judged on the menu model, never on pixels.

assertions.comment: Close appears only for an item with a window
assertions.pixel_exempt: The menu is built and its entries are read in-process, but Wayland only maps a popup for a real grabbing parent surface, so whether anything paints here is a race. Judged on the menu model, never on pixels.

assertions.comment: Settings and About are provided and enabled from every icon
assertions.pixel_exempt: The menu is built and its entries are read in-process, but Wayland only maps a popup for a real grabbing parent surface, so whether anything paints here is a race. Judged on the menu model, never on pixels.

assertions.comment: Quit is provided and enabled. Clicking it kills the app and stops capture, so only presence and enabled state are checked
